title: Maureen sitao: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Maureen sitao: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Maureen sitao is a pole sitao variety from UPLB. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Maureen sitao is a pole sitao variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2020 as NSIC 2020 Ps 06. UPLB bred it. It takes about 48 days from sowing to the first harvest, with 11.24 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Maureen sitao takes about 48 days from sowing to the first harvest. That is about the average of the 7 pole sitao varieties with a day count, 45.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 11.24 t/ha matches the average of its group, 11.33. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit sitao fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its pods grew about 45.97 cm long.
Where and when to plant Maureen sitao

It is recommended for the wet season. Pole sitao climbs a trellis and bears for weeks, while bush sitao needs no trellis and comes in at once. Pick long, dark green pods that snap cleanly, and a variety rated against the bean fly and rust if you can. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 48 days from sowing to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 11.24 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Maureen?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
